content: Supabase official guidance (docs troubleshooting): never trust getSession() on the server for authorization since it only decodes the local JWT without revalidating against the Auth server; always use getUser() (or getClaims()) in Server Components/Server Actions/middleware which makes a network round-trip to validate the token. getSession() is only safe for reading the raw access/refresh tokens, not for auth decisions. Mixing client-side session patterns into server code is the common mistake.
